issues.description: Urgent care directed an INR check at the anticoagulation clinic within 3 days, but no anticoagulation clinic record after that date appears in the production. Request the clinic records.
The ED order lists vitamin K 5 mg IV, but the medication administration record shows 10 mg given. Which dose was given, and is the difference explained?
The discharge summary gives a different endoscopy date than the endoscopy report. Which date is correct?
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole was started on 2022-05-28 while the medication list shows warfarin, and the INR was 7.8 on 2022-06-04. Was INR monitoring arranged in between?
